FROM-ZERO UI CONCEPT D — BRUTALIST SURVIVAL. Throw away the current Onslaught UI styling and rebuild the source-reconstruction interface from first principles while preserving game logic, required DOM IDs/contracts, and the working mobile input bridge. Direction: severe brutalist survival design—black, off-white, oxidized red, raw block typography, oversized numerals, hard rules, stamped labels, asymmetric composition, no glow, no neon, no glassmorphism, no cyberpunk bevels, no rounded app cards. It should feel like a desperate field manual / industrial kill-count board translated into a fast shooter HUD. Redesign start/redeploy screen, wave/hostile/kill telemetry, health, ammo/weapon display, crosshair, damage feedback, and touch-control appearance as one original system. Keep gameplay center unobstructed and landscape-phone reachability excellent with safe areas. You may replace style.css wholesale and adjust source main.js/mobile-source-bridge.js markup/styles where necessary without changing mechanics. Keep paint/layout overhead minimal. Return a substantial implementation-ready unified diff, not just findings. Do not claim tests were run.
